item.title: Traefik v3 Deep Dive: beyond basic Ingress
item.description: Traefik v3 isn’t just an IngressController. Middlewares, IngressRoute CRD, TCP/UDP routing, plugins, dashboard and observability: everything that makes Traefik a complete reverse proxy on Kubernetes.

item.title: Kubernetes Gateway API: the successor to Ingress is here
item.description: The Gateway API has been GA since Kubernetes 1.28. Here’s why it advantageously replaces Ingress, how it works, and how to set it up with Traefik.
